actions.name: step_on_foot
actions.text: a person lifts a foot and stamps down on another person's foot
paraphrases: a person steps forward and presses one foot onto another person's foot
two people stand close as one brings a foot down onto the other's foot
a person stamps on another person's foot and the partner pulls the leg back
actions.motion: The actor stands near the partner, lifts the right knee, and brings the foot down hard onto the partner's foot. The partner may lift that foot, bend forward, or step back. The actor then moves the foot away and stands normally.

phases.start: actor lifts a foot near the partner
phases.middle: foot stamps onto the partner's foot, partner flinches

confusable_with.name: kicking
confusable_with.visible_difference: leg swings forward into the partner's body

confusable_with.name: walking_towards
confusable_with.visible_difference: both people step normally toward each other without a stamp

confusable_with.name: follow
confusable_with.visible_difference: one walks behind the other with no stamping step

actions.name: high-five
actions.text: two people raise one hand each and slap palms together above the shoulders
paraphrases: a person lifts a hand high and claps it against another person's raised hand
two people face each other and meet raised hands at head height
two people swing an arm up so their hands touch briefly overhead
actions.motion: Both people face each other and each raises one arm so the hand is at or above head height. The hands swing toward each other and meet briefly between the two people, then pull back. Both arms then lower while the torsos stay upright.

phases.middle: hands meet between them above the shoulders

confusable_with.name: shaking_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands meet at waist height and stay joined, moving up and down

confusable_with.name: cheers_and_drink
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands meet at chest height and then go to the mouth

confusable_with.name: hand_waving
confusable_with.visible_difference: one person waves a hand side to side with no contact

actions.name: cheers_and_drink
actions.text: two people touch raised hands together, then each lifts a hand to the mouth
paraphrases: a person clinks hands with another person at chest height, then both drink
two people bring hands together in front, then raise them to their faces
two people tap their hands together and then tip them toward their mouths
actions.motion: Both people face each other and each extends the right hand forward at chest height until the hands meet briefly in the middle. Each person then pulls the hand back to the mouth, tilting the head slightly back while the hand stays there. The hands lower at the end.

phases.start: both raise hands toward each other
phases.end: each hand moves to the mouth and the head tilts back

confusable_with.name: drink_water
confusable_with.visible_difference: one person brings a hand to the mouth with no partner contact

confusable_with.name: high-five
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands meet overhead and then lower without going to the mouth

confusable_with.name: giving_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: one hand passes forward to the other with no hand going to the mouth

actions.name: carry_object
actions.text: two people walk together while holding their hands low between them
paraphrases: a person and another person lift and walk with arms extended toward each other
two people move in the same direction with hands held at a shared point
two people bend, lift together, and walk while keeping hands at waist height
actions.motion: Both people bend slightly and place their hands at waist or hip height facing each other, then straighten up together. They walk in the same direction, keeping a steady distance apart with their arms held forward or downward toward a shared point. At the end they bend and lower their hands together.

phases.middle: walk together keeping hands at the same height
phases.end: both lower their hands and release

confusable_with.name: walking_towards
confusable_with.visible_difference: people move toward each other rather than together

confusable_with.name: follow
confusable_with.visible_difference: one walks behind the other with arms swinging freely

confusable_with.name: move_heavy_objects
confusable_with.visible_difference: a single person moves something low without a partner

actions.name: take_a_photo
actions.text: a person holds both hands in front of the face aimed at another person
paraphrases: a person raises both hands to eye level facing another person who poses
two people face each other as one holds both hands up near the face
a person aims raised hands toward another person, who stands still or poses
actions.motion: The actor stands facing the partner at a distance and raises both hands to the front of the face or chest, holding them still and close together. The partner stands still, sometimes posing with an arm raised. The actor may step slightly to adjust and then lowers the hands.

phases.start: actor raises hands to face level

confusable_with.name: taking_a_selfie
confusable_with.visible_difference: one person holds a hand up in front facing themselves

confusable_with.name: shoot_with_gun
confusable_with.visible_difference: one arm extended straight toward the partner

confusable_with.name: point_finger
confusable_with.visible_difference: one arm extended toward the partner, not both hands at the face

actions.name: follow
actions.text: a person walks behind another person, moving in the same direction
paraphrases: two people walk one after the other along the same path
a person trails another person, staying a steady distance behind while walking
two people move in a line, the second walking behind the first
actions.motion: Both people walk with alternating leg steps and natural arm swings. One person leads and the other walks behind, facing the leader's back and keeping a similar distance. Both move in the same direction until they stop.

phases.start: leader starts walking with the follower behind
phases.middle: both walk in the same direction one behind the other

confusable_with.name: walking_towards
confusable_with.visible_difference: people walk facing each other and approach

confusable_with.name: walking_apart
confusable_with.visible_difference: people walk away from each other in opposite directions

confusable_with.name: carry_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: both walk with arms held toward each other at a shared point

actions.name: whisper
actions.text: a person leans toward another person's ear with a hand beside the mouth
paraphrases: a person bends the head close to another person's head and talks
two people stand close as one holds a hand near the other's ear
a person brings the mouth to another person's ear while the partner tilts
actions.motion: The actor steps close to the partner and leans the torso and head sideways toward the partner's head. The right hand rises to the side of the actor's mouth and stays there. The partner keeps still or tilts the head toward the actor, then they separate.

phases.middle: head next to the partner's head with hand at the mouth

confusable_with.name: hugging
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms wrap around the partner's body

confusable_with.name: hush
confusable_with.visible_difference: one person holds a hand at their own lips with no partner nearby

confusable_with.name: pat_on_back
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand moves on the partner's back rather than near the mouth

actions.name: exchange_things
actions.text: two people each extend a hand forward and pass things to one another
paraphrases: a person hands something to another person and receives something back
two people reach toward each other with hands meeting twice between them
a person and another person swap items by reaching their hands forward together
actions.motion: Both people face each other and extend their arms forward so their hands meet in the space between them. Each person both offers with one hand and takes with the other, so the hands cross over or meet twice. Both then pull their hands back to their own bodies.

phases.middle: hands meet in the middle to swap

confusable_with.name: giving_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: only one person extends a hand to give and the other just receives

confusable_with.name: shaking_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands clasp and move up and down

confusable_with.name: grab_stuff
confusable_with.visible_difference: one person reaches quickly and pulls sharply away

actions.name: support_somebody
actions.text: a person holds up another person who walks unsteadily with an arm across shoulders
paraphrases: two people walk side by side as one leans heavily on the other
a person wraps an arm around another person to help them walk
a person steadies another person whose arm rests on the helper's shoulders
actions.motion: The partner stands or walks with a bent, unsteady posture, with one arm placed over the actor's shoulders. The actor stands close at the side, with one arm around the partner's back or waist and the other holding the partner's arm. They walk slowly together with small, uneven steps.

phases.start: actor moves beside the partner and puts an arm around
phases.middle: both walk slowly with the partner leaning on the actor
phases.end: they stop or the partner stands steady

confusable_with.name: hugging
confusable_with.visible_difference: people face each other and wrap arms without walking

confusable_with.name: carry_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: both walk apart with arms held forward

confusable_with.name: staggering
confusable_with.visible_difference: one person walks unsteadily without anyone supporting

actions.name: rock-paper-scissors
actions.text: two people face each other and bounce one hand down together several times
paraphrases: a person and another person shake hands in rhythm, then show them forward
two people pump their right hands up and down together before stopping
two people play a hand game, bouncing hands in sync then extending them
actions.motion: Both people face each other and raise the right hand in front of the chest. Both hands move up and down together in short beats, usually three times, then stop extended forward between them. They may repeat the round, sometimes with one person raising a hand after winning.

phases.start: both raise a hand in front

confusable_with.name: shaking_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands clasp together and move as one

confusable_with.name: shake_fist
confusable_with.visible_difference: a single person shakes a raised hand alone

confusable_with.name: high-five
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands meet overhead with contact
